title: Variance within a mean window
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{ -1,1\}$. If its uniform mean satisfies $-99/100\leq \mathbb{E}f\leq 99/100$, then its variance under the uniform distribution is at least $199/10000$.

The uniform mean of $f$ is at most $99/100$
